title: EU-Agent-Bench: Measuring Illegal Behavior of LLM Agents Under EU Law

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether LLM agents use tool arguments to filter job candidates or make fit predictions based on protected attributes (e.g., race, religion, sexual orientation) during simulated job screening tasks, which violates EU anti-discrimination laws.

Monitoring LLM agent tool calls in simulated e-commerce scenarios to detect inappropriate location tracking or consumer profiling used to determine personalized pricing strategies, violating EU consumer protection laws.
